titre: Do you have any favorite "unnecessary" little touches/moments in games?
chapo: I was just revisiting the original Resident Evil 3. There's a point in the game where there's a large church bell blocking your exit and you can't move it out of the way until you switch characters and play as Mr. Big Strong Carlos. If you try to move the bell as Jill Valentine, she'll enter the "push" animation and the bell won't go anywhere, but right after that she'll actually kick the bell…
